rows.basis: The Q4 2024 release attributes significant gains in the Communications, Enterprise and Datacenter (CED) business to 'the critical role of precision timing in AI' (stmt:SITM|earnings_release|2024-12-31|75f371a3|revenue|FY2024|actual|0). No CED dollar figure and no AI share is stated, so no amount is attributed out of total revenue of $202.7M.

The 10-K MD&A says the $124.0M (61%) revenue increase was 'primarily driven by demand for our products in AI and datacenter applications'. Releases say CED grew 137% in Q2 'fueled by AI' and grew over 100% for seven straight quarters 'driven by AI'. No CED dollar line and no AI share is stated. The $83.6M Q3 figure is total quarterly revenue, not AI revenue. Nothing is attributed out of $326.7M.

The Q4 2025 release expects 'broad-based growth to continue, again driven by CED' in 2026 (stmt:SITM|earnings_release|2025-12-31|5fd7769a|revenue|FY2026|outlook|1). It gives no amount and does not name AI explicitly in this sentence.
